title: Learning ledger state
description: The memory ledger's .state.json: the watermark of the last observation reflected, the schedule marks of each job, and the mute switch. A watermark advances only when a reflection is accepted, so a rejected rewrite is retried on the same evidence rather than skipping it (protocol evidence-gate). The file lives in the runtime's ledger directory, never inside a project repository (ruling learning-runtime-is-host-adapter).

last_nightly.description: Local calendar date of the last nightly run.
